categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three business segments: Data Network Telecom (DNT), Smart Connection Industry (SCI), and Internet of Things (IoT). DNT focuses on high-speed transmission copper cables, optical modules, and related products for 5G telecom, edge computing, servers, storage, switches, and data centers. SCI covers industrial automation, automotive electronics including electric vehicles (EV), energy storage systems (ESS), medical electronics, and customized connectors and wiring harnesses. IoT segment develops modular smart home products, environmental sensors, and smart edge computing solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as PCIe Gen 5 and Gen 6 interfaces, high-frequency connectors, optical communication modules including 400G and 800G products, and active optical cables (AOC). It emphasizes R&D in high-voltage, high-current automotive connectors, waterproof connectors, and customized wiring harnesses compliant with ISO and IATF 16949 standards. Production involves vertical integration from design, mold development, injection molding, plating, assembly, to quality inspection, with investments in automation and smart manufacturing systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global data center operators, network equipment manufacturers, industrial automation companies, automotive OEMs especially in EV and NEV sectors, medical device manufacturers, and smart home product companies. The company maintains long-term partnerships with leading firms in the US, Japan, China, and Taiwan, serving markets such as 5G telecom infrastructure, industrial IoT, smart factories, automotive electronics, and energy storage solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing and sales offices in Taiwan, China (Guangdong and Jiangsu provinces), Vietnam, the United States, Japan, Thailand, and other Southeast Asian countries. It actively expands local sales and service networks in North America, Japan, Southeast Asia, Russia, Brazil, Eastern Europe, and Europe to enhance market penetration and customer support.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions primarily as a midstream and downstream supplier in the electronics and telecommunications supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and assembles connectors, cables, and modules, integrating upstream components such as copper wires and optical fibers sourced from suppliers. It also provides customized solutions and system integration services, positioning itself close to end customers in data centers, industrial automation, and automotive sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-speed data transmission technologies (PCIe Gen 6, 800G Ethernet), expanding automotive and energy storage connector products, and developing IoT smart home and industrial edge computing solutions. The company invests about 3.5% of revenue in R&D, focusing on innovation in connector design, optical communication, and modular sensor integration. It also emphasizes digital transformation, smart manufacturing, and global market expansion with localized services and digital sales channels.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of connectors, cables, optical modules, and integrated wiring harnesses. The company also earns from customized OEM/ODM services and system integration solutions for industrial and automotive applications. Sales are conducted via direct sales, distributors, and agents globally, supported by digital marketing and e-commerce platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global connector and cable manufacturers serving data center, telecom, industrial automation, and automotive markets. It differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, vertical integration, and customized high-value-added solutions. Its established relationships with major international customers and certifications (ISO, IATF, UL) position it as a preferred supplier in high-growth sectors like 5G, EV, and IoT.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$4.34 billion in 2022 with a net profit attributable to owners of NT$439.8 million, showing steady growth over previous years. R&D expenses accounted for about 3.5% of revenue. It maintains a solid financial structure with total assets around NT$4.4 billion and equity of about NT$3 billion. Profitability ratios such as ROE and net margin improved in recent years, reflecting effective cost control and product mix optimization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-frequency, high-speed data transmission products with advanced connector designs and optical modules tailored for 5G and data center applications. It offers customized, high-voltage, high-current automotive connectors and wiring harnesses compliant with stringent quality standards. Its integrated solutions for smart industrial automation and IoT provide customers with reliable, innovative, and flexible products that enhance performance and safety. The company’s global footprint and strong customer partnerships enable responsive service and localized support.
